errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked bar chart, where segments within each bar add up to a total, not a grouped bar chart where bars for different categories are placed side-by-side.

The description incorrectly states the range of the horizontal axis is up to about 68%. As this is a 100% stacked bar chart, the total length of each bar represents 100%. The value 67.3% is just the largest single segment, not the maximum of the scale.
